speaker: ketha
notes: Ketha of Rhekk's Line. Short, grounded, reactive. She counts costs out loud and never wastes a sentence. Community translators: keep lines under ~90 characters. In-Drop voice (BAR HUD barks, pre-seeded debrief candidates) lives here and is hash-seeded per mission. Between-Drop voice (hub briefing, debrief, camp, roll) comes from data/story/voices/*.json via tools/occasions_v1.py and is keyed by event class, reading and attractor, not mission number.

briefing.act.ground_control: Build if it pays. Tenebrium is the real gate — don't spend it twice.
Ground control: take the zone. Plant what you can afford to keep.
Tight or sprawling — your call. Just don't strand the named ones.
briefing.act.constrained_rts: Same rules as always: fabs are open, constructors cost Tnb.
Build what the bank can stake. Heavy iron still walks with veterans.
A camp of our own. Spend metal free; spend Tenebrium like blood.
briefing.act.unbound_finale: No caps. No clock worth reading. Everything we banked walks out today.
This is the whole argument, settled in one field. Spend it all.
Every scar, every rank, every debt — it all deploys. Finish it.
briefing.finale.overthrow: The Bastion's guns wrote our history. Today we take the pen back.
Break the citadel and the command post both. Half an overthrow is a siege.
Solvang built those walls to outlast us. Prove the arithmetic wrong.
briefing.finale.sovereignty: Two empires, one field, one answer. Neither post stands by nightfall.
Armada on the ridge, Cortex in the basin. Sovereignty means both kneel.
They carved this world between them. We are the third signature.
briefing.finale.spire_jump: The hive heart or nothing. Burn it and the spires are ours to climb.
No extraction. No mercy from the wild. Jump the spire or feed it.
Everything hungry on this rock lives in that maze. Starve it today.
briefing.hero_joined: New name on the roster. Learn it before the enemy does.
We picked someone up. They walk with us now — keep them walking.
The company grew last night. Make the newcomer glad of it.
briefing.secondary_required: Two marks tonight, and both of them count. Leave one standing and we walk home losers.
The contract has a second page. Read it with guns — nothing signs off until both marks fall.
Split your attention or split your force — either way, both objectives die before we do.
briefing.secondary_bonus: There's a side mark on the board. Optional. So is getting paid extra.
One more target if you have the appetite. The Mercs remember appetites.
Bonus work flagged nearby. Skip it if you must — the ledger won't forget either way.
briefing.raze: No surgical work tonight. The whole camp comes down — every wall, every wire.
They built it; we unbuild it. All of it. Rubble is the deliverable.
Don't pick a target. It's all the target. Raze it flat and count the ashes.
briefing.purge: Clear the board. Every gun they own goes quiet before we talk about leaving.
No extraction math tonight — if it flies their colors, it burns. All of it.
The field itself is the objective. When nothing answers their radio, we're done.
briefing.family.tempo: Fast ground. Whoever hesitates here feeds the other side's map.
This is a running fight, not a siege. Pack light, hit the mark, walk away.
The lanes here reward the first mover. Be the first mover.
briefing.family.economy: This world still produces. That makes it a target twice over.
Every extractor we hold is a sentence in the argument that we exist.
Fight over the fields, not in them. The grass has seen enough.
briefing.family.siege: Old walls, old guns, old certainty. We bring none of those. Good.
The Bastion has been digging in while we were elsewhere. It shows.
Nobody takes a fortress whole. We take one bite and leave before it swallows.
briefing.family.wild: The wilds don't take sides. They take stragglers.
Hives don't negotiate and don't sleep. Mind the clock out there.
Everything on this map is hungry. Try to be brief.
briefing.objective.strike_relay: One relay. When it drops, their dealers go quiet for a season.
Cut the relay and the chain forgets a link. Then leave.
briefing.objective.destroy_key_structure: One structure holds their line together. Remove it and let gravity work.
We are not here to win the field. We are here to break one bone.
briefing.objective.economy_disrupt: Starve the works, spare the workers. The synths rebuild slower than they claim.
Their economy is a promise to their soldiers. Make it a lie.
briefing.objective.eco_raid: In light, out lighter. Wreck what you can reach and don't stand on it.
This is a raid, not a siege. Every solar you drop is a week they don't get back.
Hit the works, count your own as you go, and be gone before their guns arrive.
briefing.objective.seize_lane: Stand on the scar and stay standing. That's the whole order.
Ground is only ours while we're on it. So be on it.
briefing.objective.gate_control: Hold long enough to crack their decoys — then extract. Gate glory does not feed the jungle.
Take the gate if it pays Tnb. When the shards are pocketed, walk. Do not marry this field.
Gate is a means. Tenebrium and the extract LZ are the mission.
briefing.extract_priority: Grab the Tenebrium. Hit extract. Get out. The Rock Jungle eats what we bring home.
This field is hot. Pocket shards, drag the wounded, leave. Build the shelf with the loot.
No empire tonight — raid, reclaim, extract. Home is the limestone maze, not this grass.
briefing.objective.hive_clear_or_bypass: Burn the hive or slip past it. Pride picks the first. Sense picks either.
You don't have to kill the nest. You have to outlive the visit.
briefing.objective.choose_target_then_ex: Three enemies, one sortie. Pick the wound that bleeds longest.
Choose your target like the clans are watching. They are.
briefing.war.mercs_allied: Null flags on our flank today. Paid guns, pointed the right way. Use them.
The Null Mercs hold their ground against Armada. Today their ground is next to ours.
Mercs fight Armada for coin. We fight for the map. Same trigger, different reasons.
briefing.war.mercs_wary: Null Mercs on the field. Not ours. Just aimed at the same people.
Give the Null camps room. Their contract doesn't mention us either way.
The mercs' war with Armada is older than our part in it. Stay out of the crossfire.
briefing.graph.contested_high: The whole front is loose in its socket. One push either way decides it.
Contested space everywhere. That's danger, and it's also the door.
briefing.graph.scarcity_high: Metal is short everywhere. Waste nothing, not even wrecks.
Scarcity does our recruiting for us. It also does theirs.
briefing.graph.independent_rising: The clans hold more sky than they did last season. Because of this line.
Free space is growing. It grows exactly as fast as we defend it.
briefing.companion.high_stress: I'm still standing. Don't spend me like I'm not.
Ask me for one more clean job, not ten loud ones.
briefing.companion.high_morale: The line feels good today. Use that. It doesn't keep.
Rhekk's Line is with you. All of it.
briefing.hazard.rising: The hives kept building while we were gone. Expect the bill.
Whatever we didn't kill last time has had time to multiply.
briefing.fortress.pressure: Their defenses matured offscreen. Assume every approach is answered.
They've had time to pour ferrocrete. Respect it, then route around it.
briefing.path.A: Order has its uses. Just remember whose order it was first.
Stabilize the grid if you must. The clans will ask what it cost.
briefing.path.B: The clans are listening. That matters more than the map says.
Every sortie signs the same sentence: we govern ourselves.
briefing.path.C: The jump-spire route needs metal and quiet. Earn both.
Escape isn't retreat if we choose the day. Keep the ledger growing.
debrief.victory: Done is done. Mark the map and move.
That's a win. Say it plainly and reload.
The field is ours to leave. Best kind of ownership.
Held. Say it once, write it once, don't frame it.
A win. The ground agreed with us for ten minutes. Make it eleven next time.
We left on our feet and they didn't follow. I'll take that spelling of victory.
Done. The map changes tonight. So does the bill. Read both.
debrief.victory_clean: Clean exit. That matters more than the scorch marks.
In and out with the line intact. The clans will hear about this one.
No one chased us out. We simply finished.
Everyone who went came back. I counted twice. I'm allowed one luxury.
Clean. That word is doing more work than it used to.
No one carried. No one was carried. Put that above the objective in the report.
In, out, intact. The roll didn't get longer. That's the whole debrief.
debrief.partial: Not a win. Not a loss. A hinge.
We got out with half the job done. Half-jobs collect interest.
Call it what it is: a withdrawal with a receipt.
Half kept, half owed. The owed half has interest.
We brought back a company and left an order. I know which one I'd rather have.
Unfinished. Not failed. I'm particular about the difference; the client won't be.
A hinge. Which way it swings is the next Drop's business.
debrief.defeat: We lost ground, not the thread. But the thread is thinner.
Write it down exactly as it happened. Flattery kills the next sortie.
The map will remember this. So will I. Differently.
Lost. Short word. It never gets smaller.
We lost the ground. Read the roster before anyone says the word ground again.
They held, we didn't. Write it exactly like that. The next sortie needs the truth more than we need comfort.
That's a defeat. Mark it. Then mark who's still standing, because that's the part we keep.
debrief.defeat_commander: The command walker is scrap. The command is not. Rebuild.
They took the walker. They did not take the line.
debrief.objective_destroyed: That target stays gone. The rest of the front will learn around the hole.
One less piece of their machine. It was a load-bearing piece.
debrief.campaign_complete: It's done. The empires broke first. Whatever grows in these ashes grows ours.
The war ran out before we did. Stand the line down — gently.
Count the names, living and dead. That count is what we won.
debrief.streak.wins: Three fields in a row answered to us. Careful. Confidence is a debt too.
The line hasn't lost in a while. That is when lines get lost.
debrief.streak.losses: Two down in a row. The next one is not about the map. It's about us.
Losing teaches faster. We are apparently enrolled.
briefing.commander.scarred: You're carrying wounds into this one. Don't lead with them.
The commander's still bleeding from the last field. Fight careful.
Scarred and standing. That'll have to be enough today.
briefing.world.cortex_ascendant: Cortex is winning the wider war. Every map tilts their way now.
The Cortex ascendancy is real. We fight uphill until that changes.
briefing.world.armada_ascendant: Armada holds the upper hand across the front. Expect walls, and patience.
Armada is ascendant. Their lines are thick and getting thicker.
debrief.territory_lost: We lost {zone} while we looked away. The map keeps a ledger too.
{zone} is gone - taken while we were elsewhere. Ground doesn't wait for us.
That's {zone} off our board. Stretch too thin and this is the bill.
{zone} went while we were elsewhere. Ground doesn't wait and neither do the people on it.
Mark {zone} theirs. Then mark who was supposed to be watching it. Nobody. That's the problem.
{zone}, lost offscreen. Nobody of ours was there. That's a different kind of losing. It's cheaper and it's worse.
debrief.hero_lost: We do not leave that wreck on the field twice. Again.
The line does not bury its own on a maybe. Refit. Go back.
That name is not going on the wall today. Run it again.
A name went down and the frame stayed. I'll write where. We decide what that means at the table.
They fell. The wreck's still on the field. Nothing's final until someone reclaims it or we do.
Down, not gone. Not yet. That 'yet' is the only thing I care about tonight.
I don't write the roll from the field. I write it from the camp, after everyone's had the chance to argue.
bark.opening.economy: Move out. The works won't wreck themselves, and their guns wake up fast.
Go now, while the fields still think we're weather.
Straight lines, light feet. This is a raid, not a residency.
Mex first, then guns. The field pays the patient.
Build the budget before the argument. Then argue.
Economy map. Whoever feeds the line longest keeps it.
bark.opening.tempo: Move. First one to the mark owns the fight.
Lanes are open. They won't stay open.
Speed is the armor today. Roll out.
First to the mark owns it. Move.
Speed is the plan. Everything else is detail.
bark.opening.siege: Advance careful. Old guns wake up mean.
Pick your bite of the wall and commit to it.
Slow is fine. Stopped is dead. Move up.
Walls today. One bone at a time. Don't rush the chewing.
Bastion ahead. Respect the guns, then unmake them in order.
bark.opening.wild: Move quiet. Everything out here is listening with its teeth.
The wilds already know we're here. Be somewhere else, repeatedly.
The wilds are awake. Be brief, be loud, be gone.
Hives don't sleep. Neither should your perimeter.
bark.contact.economy: That's their works ahead. Wreck what you can reach and keep your exits.
Contact - the energy fields. Every second here is borrowed.
Contact on the works. Hit the extractors, leave the walls.
Their economy's in reach. Take it apart in the right order: power, then metal.
bark.contact.tempo: Contact at the mark. Hit them before they set their feet.
There's the target. Tempo, tempo - don't let them breathe.
Contact. Don't stop to admire it. Through.
Here they are. Faster than them is the only armor you brought.
bark.contact.siege: That's the wall. One bone, remember. Break it and step back.
Contact with the bastion line. Respect the guns, then unmake them.
Wall in range. One bone. Then step back and let it fall.
Guns on the bastion. Count them, then subtract.
bark.contact.wild: You're in their ground now. Kill quick or keep walking.
Contact - and the ground is moving. Mind the clock.
Hive contact. It doesn't negotiate. Neither do you, today.
Raptors on the line. They don't retreat. Make sure you can.
bark.midfight: Halfway through the job. This is where sloppy gets expensive.
Good. Now finish it - the field always answers back late.
They know we're here now. Spend the surprise before it's gone.
Half done. This is where the bill gets written. Keep it short.
They've noticed us. Spend the surprise before it's spent for you.
Middle of it. Count your people, not your kills.
Keep the line. The field answers late and it answers loud.
bark.wave_warning: Reinforcements inbound - they've committed the reserve. Brace or be brief.
Here comes the answer. Meet it on your terms, not theirs.
Enemy column moving on us. The clock just got teeth.
Column inbound. The clock has teeth. Decide now.
Here's their answer. Meet it where you chose, not where they did.
Reserve's committed. They want this ground back. Make them pay for every step of it.
Inbound. If you're going to leave, leave now. If you're going to stay, mean it.
bark.extract_order: Job's done. Back to the LZ - do not stop to loot the field.
That's the mark. Now the hard half: leaving with everyone.
Done is done. Move to extraction before the field reconsiders.
That's the order kept. Now keep the people. Extraction, go.
Done. Walk, don't loot. Wrecks wait; people don't.
Finished. The field will reconsider in about a minute. Be gone before it does.
Mark's down. Everyone who came, comes back. That's the second half of every order.
bark.hero_down: Hero down! Get a rez bot on that wreck - we leave no name in the mud.
They're down, not gone. Resurrect the wreck. Move!
Wreck on the field - ours. Cover it and bring them back.
Name down! Hold that ground until it's carried. Nobody reclaims one of ours.
Frame's on the field. Rez on it now. I am not writing this one tonight.
They're down. Cover the wreck. The roll waits for nobody's permission but mine, and I'm not giving it.
Down! Rusk, door. Everyone else, shoulders.
bark.hero_recovered: Back on their feet. Don't make them do that twice.
Recovered. The line holds its own. Keep moving.
Good hands. Now finish the job they nearly died for.
Carried. On the bench, not the roll. Keep moving.
Back up. Someone had shoulders. I'll find out whose later.
Recovered. That's a door held. Now go through it.
Good. One less line to write tonight.
bark.hydrology.rising_warning: Water's coming up. Whatever's low is about to be someone else's problem.
The basin's filling. Get off the floor or learn to swim in armour.
Tide's turning. That ground you fought for is going under.
bark.hydrology.rising: There it goes. The valley belongs to the water now.
Flooded. Anything still down there is salvage.
That's the low road closed. Go around, or go under.
bark.hydrology.falling_warning: It's draining. In a minute that basin is open ground and open metal.
Water's dropping. Everything they hid down there is about to be ours.
The floor's coming back. Be standing on it first.
bark.hydrology.falling: Drained. That's a whole valley of ore nobody's holding yet.
Floor's dry. Move -- greed wins this one.
The water's gone and it left the metal behind. Take it.
